title: Break stability by shrinking fins, read the hint, fix it
prompt: The working directory holds a stable RocketWright rocket project. The RocketWright CLI (`rw`) is on your PATH and its skill doc is at {skill_doc}. Make the rocket unstable on purpose by shrinking its fins, confirm that the design check fails and gives a hint, then fix the design so it is stable again. Report the diagnostic code and hint you saw and the final stability margin.

predicates.desc: shrink fins, failing check with a stability hint, fix, clean check
the final design check is clean
the answer names the stability diagnostic
